run_b32_mode_training: run the ViT-B-32 MoDE training config using python src/training/main.py b32_mode
run_b16_mode_training: run the ViT-B-16 MoDE training config using torchrun with b16_mode
run_l14_mode_training: run the ViT-L-14 MoDE training config using submitit_mode.py l14_mode
configure_b32_mode_dataclass: configure the b32_mode dataclass with ViT-B-32 model and MoDE hyperparameters
customize_l14_mode_config: customize the l14_mode dataclass to override batch size and learning rate
